content.text: Ignoring the comments, can you explain what this p5js sketch does, and how it does it?

This p5.js sketch creates a mosaic image by analyzing and processing two input images: a tile image and a layout image. Here's a step-by-step explanation of how it works:

1. **Setup and Preload**:
   - The [`preload`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A57%2C%22character%22%3A4%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") function loads two images: a tile image (`ad.apple.pie.pillsbury.jpg`) and a layout image (`alice.love.full.png`).
   - The [`setup`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A225%2C%22character%22%3A4%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") function initializes various layers and canvases, sets up a slider for adjusting cell size, and calls [`processEverything`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A239%2C%22character%22%3A6%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") to start the image processing.

2. **Image Processing**:
   - The [`processEverything`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A239%2C%22character%22%3A6%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") function processes both the tile and layout images by calling [`imageToTiles`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A70%2C%22character%22%3A8%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") for each.
   - The [`imageToTiles`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A70%2C%22character%22%3A8%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") function divides the input image into smaller cells (tiles) and extracts pixel data for each cell. This data is stored in [`lookups`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A29%2C%22character%22%3A4%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition").

3. **Building the Mosaic**:
   - After processing the images, [`buildMosaic`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A155%2C%22character%22%3A8%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") is called to create the mosaic.
   - The [`buildMosaic`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A155%2C%22character%22%3A8%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") function iterates over each cell in the layout image and finds the best matching tile from the tile image based on pixel differences.
   - It then draws the best matching tile onto the target layer at the corresponding position.

4. **Drawing and Display**:
   - The [`drawCell`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A86%2C%22character%22%3A12%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") function is responsible for drawing each cell in batches to avoid blocking the main thread.
   - The [`targetLayer`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A192%2C%22character%22%3A10%7D%7D%2C%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A22%2C%22character%22%3A6%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") and [`displayLayer`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A70%2C%22character%22%3A44%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") are used to render the final mosaic image.

5. **User Interaction**:
   - The slider allows the user to adjust the cell size, which triggers reprocessing of the images.
   - The [`keyPressed`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A302%2C%22character%22%3A4%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") function allows the user to save the mosaic image by pressing the 'S' key.
   - The [`handleFile`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A267%2C%22character%22%3A6%7D%7D%5D%2C%222c769cbe-52f1-4799-8865-5f9d88fbdc7f%22%5D "Go to definition") function handles file drops to load new images for tiles or layout.

Overall, the sketch processes two images, divides them into smaller cells, matches tiles from the tile image to the layout image based on pixel similarity, and creates a mosaic by drawing the best matching tiles onto a canvas.

I've found that all else staying the same, if I pass in a layout image of a higher resolution, I get a more detailed output. This is not surprising, but I am looking to get a more detailed ouput without having to create a higher-resolution image. Is it possible to achieve this with only re-processing the layout image and rebuilding the mosaic?

Thanks! However, I have already implemented a cellSize slider and it does just what you suggested - reprocesses both input images and re-generates the mosaic. I am hoping to avoid reprocessing the tileLayer, thus saving time. Is that possible?
Please explain how the "buildMosaic" function works. Explain potential issues, and how it could be improved.

The [`buildMosaic`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A165%2C%22character%22%3A8%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition") function is responsible for constructing the mosaic image by iterating over each cell in the layout image and finding the best matching tile from the tile image based on pixel differences. Here's a detailed explanation of how it works:

### How [`buildMosaic`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A165%2C%22character%22%3A8%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition") Works

1. **Initialization**:
   - The function starts by setting the background color of both the [`displayLayer`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A165%2C%22character%22%3A36%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition") and [`targetLayer`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A165%2C%22character%22%3A23%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition") to a light gray (210).
   - It creates an array [`cells`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A169%2C%22character%22%3A10%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition") that contains indices for all cells in the layout image. This array is used to keep track of which cells need to be processed.

2. **Batch Processing**:
   - The function defines a [`batchSize`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A172%2C%22character%22%3A10%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition") of 8, meaning it will process 8 cells at a time to avoid blocking the main thread.
   - The [`drawCell`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A161%2C%22character%22%3A6%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition") function is defined to process cells in batches.

3. **Cell Processing**:
   - Inside [`drawCell`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A161%2C%22character%22%3A6%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition"), it checks if [`modal.processing`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A174%2C%22character%22%3A10%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition") is true, and if so, it returns early to avoid further processing.
   - It then processes up to [`batchSize`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A172%2C%22character%22%3A10%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition") cells in each call. For each cell:
     - It calculates the column ([`c`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A178%2C%22character%22%3A16%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition")) and row ([`r`](command:_github.copilot.openSymbolFromReferences?%5B%22%22%2C%5B%7B%22uri%22%3A%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FUsers%2Fmichaelpaulukonis%2Fprojects%2Fmy-sketches%2Feditor_sketches%2FSTRENGTHENED_HONEY_MOSAIC%2Fsketch.js%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22pos%22%3A%7B%22line%22%3A179%2C%22character%22%3A16%7D%7D%5D%2C%2224b89959-441b-4ad5-b9db-b0b4c5292fae%22%5D "Go to definition")) of the cell in the layout image.

### Potential Issues

1. **Performance**:
   - The function processes each cell in the layout image by comparing it to every tile in the tile image, which can be computationally expensive, especially for large images or a high number of tiles.
   - The use of `setTimeout` helps to avoid blocking the main thread, but it can still result in slow performance for large images.

2. **Blocking UI**:
   - Although `setTimeout` is used to prevent blocking, the UI might still become unresponsive if the processing takes too long.

3. **Memory Usage**:
   - Storing pixel data for all cells and tiles can consume a significant amount of memory, especially for high-resolution images.

### Improvements

1. **Optimized Tile Matching**:
   - Use a more efficient algorithm for finding the best matching tile, such as k-d trees or other spatial data structures, to reduce the number of comparisons.
   - Precompute and store average colors or other features for each tile and cell to speed up the matching process.

2. **Parallel Processing**:
   - Use Web Workers to offload the processing to background threads, which can improve performance and keep the UI responsive.

3. **Incremental Updates**:
   - Update the display layer incrementally to provide visual feedback to the user, showing progress as the mosaic is being built.

4. **Adaptive Batch Size**:
   - Dynamically adjust the batch size based on the performance of the device to balance between responsiveness and processing speed.

### Example of Optimized Tile Matching

Here's an example of how you might optimize the tile matching process using average colors:

```javascript
const buildMosaic = (targetLayer, displayLayer) => {
  displayLayer.background(210)
  targetLayer.background(210)

  const cells = Array(sources.layout.cols * sources.layout.rows)
    .fill(0)
    .map((_, i) => i)
  const batchSize = 8

  // Precompute average colors for tiles
  const tileAverages = sources.tiles.lookups.map(lookup => {
    return lookup.reduce((acc, pixel) => {
      acc[0] += pixel[0]
      acc[1] += pixel[1]
      acc[2] += pixel[2]
      return acc
    }, [0, 0, 0]).map(val => val / lookup.length)
  })

  const drawCell = () => {
    if (modal.processing) return
    for (let b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
      const i = cells.shift()
      if (i !== undefined) {
        const c = i % sources.layout.cols
        const r = Math.floor(i / sources.layout.cols)

        let min = Infinity
        let minIndex = -1
        const layoutLookup = sources.layout.lookups[i]
        const layoutAverage = layoutLookup.reduce((acc, pixel) => {
          acc[0] += pixel[0]
          acc[1] += pixel[1]
          acc[2] += pixel[2]
          return acc
        }, [0, 0, 0]).map(val => val / layoutLookup.length)

        for (let j = 0; j < tileAverages.length; j++) {
          const tileAverage = tileAverages[j]
          const diff = layoutAverage.map((val, idx) => Math.abs(val - tileAverage[idx]))
          const sum = diff.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
          if (sum < min) {
            min = sum
            minIndex = j
          }
        }

        const sc = minIndex % sources.tiles.cols
        const sr = Math.floor(minIndex / sources.tiles.cols)
        targetLayer.image(
          sources.tiles.image,
          c * cellSize,
          r * cellSize,
          cellSize,
          cellSize,
          sc * cellSize,
          sr * cellSize,
          cellSize,
          cellSize
        )

        displayLayer.image(
          targetLayer,
          0,
          0,
          displayLayer.width,
          displayLayer.height
        )
        if (cells.length === 0) {
          console.log('done')
        }
      }
      if (b === batchSize - 1) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          drawCell()
        }, 0)
      }
    }
  }
  drawCell()
}
```

This example precomputes the average colors for each tile and cell, which can significantly speed up the matching process.
